items.exampleEn: She has a small patch of white hair above her ear.
items.exampleZh: 她耳朵上方有一小撮白頭髮。

items.exampleEn: The baby's gaze followed the red balloon.
items.exampleZh: 嬰兒的目光一直跟著那顆紅氣球。

items.exampleEn: The runners have three more laps to go.
The new software integrates email and calendars in one place.
items.exampleZh: 這套新軟體把電子郵件和行事曆整合在一起。

items.exampleEn: She slammed the book down on the desk in anger.
items.exampleZh: 她生氣地把書用力摔在桌上。

items.exampleEn: Children under five were excluded from the survey.
items.exampleZh: 五歲以下的兒童不列入這次調查。

items.exampleEn: Reverse the order of the numbers, so 1, 2, 3 becomes 3, 2, 1.
items.exampleZh: 把數字的順序反過來，1、2、3 就變成 3、2、1。

items.exampleEn: The workers pleaded for more time to finish the job.
items.exampleZh: 工人們懇求多給一些時間完成工作。

items.sentenceEn: The truck driver slowly reversed into the narrow street.
items.sentenceZh: 卡車司機慢慢地倒車進入那條窄巷。

items.audioEn: Please don't slam the door; the baby is sleeping upstairs.
items.audioZh: 請不要用力關門，寶寶在樓上睡覺。

items.sentenceEn: The cat sat on my lap and fell asleep.
There is a dry patch of grass where the tent was.
items.sentenceZh: 搭過帳篷的地方有一塊乾掉的草地。

items.stemEn: The price ____ breakfast, so you have to pay extra for it.
items.stemZh: 這個價格不包含早餐，所以早餐要另外付費。

items.stemEn: The boy ____ with his mother to let him stay up late.
items.stemZh: 那個男孩懇求媽媽讓他晚點睡。

items.passageEn: When Leo moved from Brazil to Taiwan, he found it hard to integrate into his new school. In the first week, some boys excluded him from their basketball games because he spoke little Chinese. Leo did not plead for a chance to play. Instead, he practiced alone every evening, running lap after lap around the court. One evening, he could feel someone's gaze on him: the school coach had been watching him practice. The coach invited him to join the team and liked his innovative way of passing the ball. Today, Leo's old jeans have a patch on one knee from all the falls, but he is one of the best players on the team.
items.passageZh: Leo 從巴西搬到台灣時，很難融入新學校。第一週，有些男生不讓他一起打籃球，因為他不太會說中文。Leo 沒有去求別人給他上場的機會。他反而每天晚上獨自練習，繞著球場跑了一圈又一圈。有一天晚上，他感覺到有人在看他：原來學校的教練一直在看他練球。教練邀請他加入校隊，也很欣賞他富有創意的傳球方式。如今，Leo 的舊牛仔褲因為常跌倒，膝蓋上多了一塊補丁，但他已經是隊上最好的球員之一。

questions.questionZh: 第一週有些男生做了什麼？
教練為什麼注意到 Leo？
options: 他在比賽中投進了很多球
他的中文說得比別人好很多
他每晚獨自練習被看見

items.promptZh: 我們要把兩個團隊整合成一個部門。
referenceEn: We need to integrate the two teams into one department.
We have to integrate the two teams into a single department.
rubricZh: integrate 的用法，例如 integrate A into B、integrate A and B 等
「要」可寫，例如 need to、have to、will 等

items.promptZh: 我哥哥輸了比賽之後，用力甩上了房門。
referenceEn: My brother slammed his bedroom door after he lost the game.
After losing the game, my older brother slammed the door of his room.
rubricZh: slam 指「用力甩上」（例如 slammed the door 等）
「輸了比賽之後」可寫，例如 after he lost the game、after losing the game 等，位置不限
用過去式（例如 slammed、lost 等）
